pages.text: Each swing is one of three $(l)variants$(), rolled at random:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Default$(): the weapon's usual swing.$(li)$(4)Heavy$(): rare, slower, hits harder.$(li)$(9)Light$(): rare, quicker, hits softer.

How common the rare swings are, and how far they stray from the default, depends on the weapon type.$(br2)The cooldown bar under the crosshair is tinted $(4)red$() after a heavy swing and $(9)blue$() after a light one, so you can always read what just happened.$(br2)Heavy swings build much more Overpower pressure; light swings build less.
